source.oracle_profile: pinned source and admitted HTML5 RNG behavior

physical_inputs.conditional: used only when angle_curved is true

curve_behavior.amplitude_curve: required represented curve; sampled at 129 points from 0 through 1
curve_behavior.direction_curve: optional represented curve when angle_curved is true; sampled at 33 points from 0 through 1
curve_behavior.sampling: clamp table coordinate to [0,1] and linearly interpolate neighboring samples
curve_behavior.amplitude_coordinate: when clamp_curve is true normalize (ratio-range.min)/(range.max-range.min), add shift, then apply source frac wrapping; otherwise start from ratio, add shift, then source frac wrapping
curve_behavior.direction_coordinate: fixed direction uses angle curve at ratio when present, otherwise ratio

sampling.range_gate: outside Range, forward the child sample without wave displacement or weight change
sampling.non_loop_ratio: clamp active ratio and normal probes to [0,0.99]
sampling.loop_ratio: source pfract wrapping for active ratio and normal probes
sampling.path_normal: sample child at ratio-0.01, ratio, ratio+0.01; point direction of after-before plus 90 degrees
sampling.fixed_direction: lerp Angle endpoints using angle curve value or ratio
sampling.iteration: sum each mode value times current amplitude scale; add iterative frequency, multiply iterative amplitude, and add shift plus one continuing random draw to phase per iteration
sampling.displacement: offset the child point along the selected direction by randomized amplitude times curved progress
sampling.weight: preserve child weight unless enabled; then replace, add, or multiply by lerp(weight range, progress)

rng.admitted_profile: HTML5 InitRandom/randReal behavior exercised by pinned source fixtures
rng.seeded_range: seed floor(seed), draw random(1), reseed floor(seed)+1, draw random(1), interpolate draws by frac(seed), then interpolate the requested endpoints
rng.seed_conversion: finite numeric seed wraps through signed 32-bit truncation semantics before reseeding or frac
rng.row_and_line_seed: processor row is added to authored runtime seed; sample line is added for local seed; amplitude, phase, and frequency draws add line again, with phase and frequency offsets of one and two; wiggle uses the row-plus-line seed
rng.wiggle: one-octave perlin1D profile, smoothstep interpolation between two seeded noise draws, remapped to Wiggle Amplitude
rng.iteration_stream: with wiggle disabled, continue from the final reseeded frequency range stream; with wiggle enabled, continue from the final two-draw Noise stream; consume one draw for every iteration, including the final iteration
rng.other_runtime_profiles: desktop, licensed executable, and live runtime behavior remain unknown

path_metrics.length_multiplier: max(1, abs(max(frequency endpoints))) * sqrt(abs(max(amplitude endpoints)) + 1/max(1, abs(max(frequency endpoints))))
path_metrics.accumulated_length: multiply each child accumulated length by the same length multiplier
path_metrics.distance_sampling: source getPointDistance divides by getLength() before ratio sampling

state_and_cache.processor_arrays: process each selected row independently; add processor row to seed and store a row-specific data replay value
state_and_cache.buffers: three reusable child point buffers for path-normal probes, one center buffer for fixed direction; point buffers retain position, weight, point class, and optional Z
state_and_cache.memo_lifetime: evaluation-owned path memo, keyed by node, port, route, line, and six-decimal ratio key
state_and_cache.cache_behavior: source processData clears cached_pos on every producer update while retaining the three point buffers; saved getter descriptors can import saved cache entries into the evaluation memo; only commit a completed sample and its key; memo does not outlive one graph evaluation

admission_and_bounds.work_accounting: pre-admit each processor row; include iteration allowance, amplitude and optional direction curve generation, child path runtime work multiplied by three for path-normal or one for fixed direction, retained previous getter payload traversal and validation twice for preflight plus execution, and replay entries
admission_and_bounds.runtime_path_work_accounting: estimate nested Wave curves, cache comparisons, iterations, and child sampling before PathRuntime initialization; divide by processor count
admission_and_bounds.memo_limit_scope: per evaluation across identity lookup, cache lookup, child samples, and iteration steps
admission_and_bounds.payload: finite controls and curve samples; iteration in [0,4096]; amplitude curve exactly 129 samples; optional direction curve exactly 33; bounded unique cache keys per line
admission_and_bounds.bytes: admit cloned path, wave controls and tables, data replay entry, and processor-row aggregate against MaximumEvaluationBytes before output publication

pxcx_io_contract.physical_controls: all 25 physical controls are preserved on import and reopen
pxcx_io_contract.edits: PxcxInputValueEdit supports physical socket values only

synthetic_attribute_flags.amplitude_curved: no inverse attribute edit API; explicit toggle edits are atomically refused
synthetic_attribute_flags.angle_curved: no inverse attribute edit API; explicit toggle edits are atomically refused
synthetic_attribute_flags.preservation: refused edits preserve the original curve attributes

supported_domain.rng: admitted HTML5 random functions and pinned source helpers
supported_domain.coverage: source curves, range gates, modes, direction modes, weights, seeds, processor rows, cache/buffer refresh, native and PXC persistence, animation edits, groups, arrays, linked controls, malformed descriptor refusal
supported_domain.negative_iteration: unverified in the pinned executable and explicitly refused by the bounded profile
supported_domain.seed_requirement: source constructor seed observation required unless an explicit numeric seed is authored
